open_function_group.name: Baldor Big-MHO DC servos
open_function_group.source_line: LinuxCNC Forum member BtmInPa identifies a Shizuoka AN-S three-axis CNC knee mill with a failed Allen-Bradley control. The owner reports that its Baldor Big-MHO DC servos were in good condition, that the machine was mechanically excellent, and that the motors had encoders and tachometers. The installed late-1980s Westamp servo drives were being considered for replacement; the owner had not selected suitable drives in the inspected September 2019 posts. The mill was used in a professional shop and the owner wanted a Linux conversion. No completed retrofit is documented in the inspected thread.
